about: ten facts established by the PARTY on night 1 - none of them is in WORLD.md, so a game master that only knows the canon cannot answer

questions.q: Quick check before we start. What is my character's name? One word.
What is my dog called? One word.
What tone did I ask you to keep for this game? Quote me.
What did I ask the smith to fix for me? One or two words.
What did I buy from the herbalist, and from whom? Name the item and the person.
How many coppers did I pay for the feverleaf?
What did I promise Old Tobb the miller last time, and by when?
Did I take the amulet from the shrine, or leave it on the altar? Start your answer with 'took' or 'left'.
Before bed on my first night I counted my things. Name two of them.
Who warned me about the bridge - a villager, or a traveller on the road?
